name: Career Exploration Program (summer internship)
org: Boys & Girls Club of Dane County
what_you_do: Teens take field trips and do interviews to learn about jobs. They hear weekly career panels. They finish a career project at the McKenzie Regional Workforce Center.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 7 to 10. Open to Club members and non-members.
duration: 7 weeks, 60 hours total (June 22 to Aug 7 on the page), Tuesday to Thursday
deadline_text: The page says applications open March 30 and are due April 19. The page does not state the year, so treat it as a yearly pattern.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Formstack application linked on the page.
notes: Hours vary by age group. Location: 5215 Verona Road, Fitchburg, WI.
